summary: A tab list with a sliding indicator, horizontal or vertical, in three sizes and four shapes, with optional icons, counters and panels.

props.name: items
props.description: Each tab's `value` and `label`, plus optional `icon`, `iconOnly`, `count`, `disabled` and `panel`. `label` stays the accessible name when `iconOnly` hides it.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The tab selected on first render. Falls back to the first item. Pair `value` with `onValueChange` instead if you are controlling it.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the newly selected tab's `value`.

props.name: orientation
props.description: `vertical` stacks the tabs and sits any panels beside them rather than below.

props.name: size
props.description: Tab padding and label size together.

props.name: shape
props.description: Corner radius on the list, the tabs and the indicator. The list takes one step more than the tabs inside it, so a tab's corner never pokes past the container's.

props.name: iconPosition
props.description: Which end of a tab its `icon` sits at. Ignored when `iconOnly` is set.

props.name: animate
props.description: The indicator's slide between tabs. Turn it off for an instant jump, or when the user has asked for reduced motion.

props.name: className
props.description: Appended to the root's classes, for anything the component leaves unset - a margin, `fs-0` in a flex row. It will not reliably override what the component already sets: which of two utilities wins is decided by the stylesheet's rule order, not by the order you write them. Use `size` for the dimensions.
